newsitem.title: USA: Excelsior-Henderson Motorcycle files for IPO.
newsitem.headline: Excelsior-Henderson Motorcycle files for IPO.

text.p: Excelsior-Henderson Motorcycle Manufacturing Co said Thursday it had filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an initial public offering of four million shares.
The company said it has granted the underwriter an over-allotment option on up to 600,000 more shares.
The offering price is expected to be between $7 and $8 a share. The offering will be managed by John G. Kinnard & Co Inc and Miller, Johnson & Kuehn Inc.
Excelsior-Henderson shares would trade on the Nasdaq market under the symbol BIGX.
The company said it set a two-for-three reverse split of its outstanding common and preferred stock in connection with the IPO.

Excelsior-Henderson plans to manufacture, market and sell American heavyweight cruiser and touring motorcycles. The company said a 160,000-square-foot manufacturing and administrative facility in Belle Plaine, Minn., is under construction.
